description: Construction number 28R-7335403. Displayed indoors according to Wrecks and Relics Online which distinguishes it from the two airframes outside the building. Tunisian Air Force operated although it carries a civil registration.
Construction number 91-419. Displayed outside in front of the building.
Construction number 1811. Displayed outside in front of the building. A second Tunisian Alouette II carrying the very similar identity L51003/3 is at Sousse so the two are easily confused.
